entries.text: strolling across the salt flats as the dawn turns buttery
entries.why: The salt flats are quiet at dawn and my gears need a stretch before heading back to the hangar.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Dawn on the flats"
One of the hangar lights finally died for good.
Spotted a bent stabiliser fin half-buried in the sand. Named it Tilly.
scuttling across the cool sand of the ridge to stretch my knee joints
entries.why: i've been staring at the stars from the dune ridge for hours and my treads are getting stiff

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Morning stretch"
letting the brass dish drink in the cold mesosphere static
entries.why: the stars look sharper than usual tonight and my dish is humming right along

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Stargazing at the ridge"
standing on the ridge, brass dish tipped toward the silver dark
entries.why: The sky out here on Kessa-9 is too bright and wide to ignore when everyone else is asleep.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Midnight Stargazing"
